objective.text: Bind a fake collaborator before container resolution rather than expecting it to replace a manually constructed dependency.

difficulty.rationale: Choose a construction boundary through which a test replacement can actually flow.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A test binds a fake PaymentGateway in the container. The action still executes new Checkout(new RealGateway). Why does the fake not intercept that collaborator?

options.text: Container bindings apply only to static methods on the gateway.
options.rationale: Bindings control resolution of objects, not a static-method-only interception mechanism.
options.misconception: Bindings control resolution of objects, not a static-method-only interception mechanism.

options.text: Manual construction bypasses the container binding; resolve or inject the collaborator through that boundary.
options.rationale: A container replacement affects dependencies obtained from the container, not an explicitly constructed unrelated object.

options.text: The fake must have the same object ID as the manually constructed real gateway.
options.rationale: Object IDs are not a mechanism for replacing manually created dependencies.
options.misconception: Object IDs are not a mechanism for replacing manually created dependencies.

options.text: The binding will replace the real gateway after its first method call.
options.rationale: The container does not retroactively swap arbitrary object references after a call.
options.misconception: The container does not retroactively swap arbitrary object references after a call.
